verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce product catalog API with an MCP server that connects to Claude, ChatGPT and others, so an in-chat checkout story is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers product discovery and lookup, plus affiliate buy URLs that attribute sales and redirect to the retailer. There is no documented capability for buyers to complete a purchase inside a chat or assistant surface, and no merchant-side mechanism for listing products for agent checkout.
